repo_notes.content: JellyFlam3 Server is a self-hosted generative media pipeline: flam3 renders flame-fractal genomes to H.264 MP4 loops, catalogs them in Jellyfin under /media/sheep/by-generation/, and streams to Roku (VoD + stills screensaver) and Kodi (video screensaver). The Raspberry Pi is the furnace (render factory); TVs/clients are the pasture (playback only).
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: FLEET HOSTS (operator reference): Furnace Pis rpi-jellyflam3-{16,08,04}a at their LAN IPs; install path /opt/jellyflam3-server; user jellyflam3. Kodi pasture host (e.g. rpi-kodi-08a) on LibreELEC — no worker. Roku clients on the LAN. Jellyfin on furnace LAN IP :8096 — clients must use LAN IP, never 127.0.0.1.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: JELLYFIN FLOCK QUERY QUIRK (critical): Jellyfin 10.x ParentId=Sheep library + Recursive Movie/Video often returns a PARTIAL flock (e.g. 1 of 6) when MP4s live under by-generation/{gen}/ child folders. All clients (Roku VoD JellyfinTask.brs, Roku SS StillsTask.brs, Kodi jellyfin_flock.py, scripts/jellyfin_id_dump.py) MUST walk child Folder items and merge/dedupe — empty-only fallback is insufficient. Sideload Roku 1.0.28 / 1.0.7 and Kodi 0.2.6+.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: JELLYFIN IMAGES (Primary/Backdrop): live catalog posters and screensaver frames live under stills/{stem}/ with stills/.ignore — Jellyfin does not attach local Primary/Backdrop from those JPEGs. Clients need ImageTags.Primary / BackdropImageTags from POST /Items/{id}/Images/{type}. Jellyfin 10.9+ ImageController wraps the POST body in FromBase64Transform; pipeline.encode_image_upload_body base64-encodes JPEG/PNG. Raw image bytes 500 FormatException. Sidecar local_primary and disk-only stills are not complete; backfill_posters re-uploads.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: SECRETS AND CONFIG: Never document or commit secrets.env, filled jellyflam3.yaml, or API keys. Reference secrets.env / JELLYFIN_API_KEY only. Sheep library ParentId must point at Sheep virtual folder (path /media/sheep/by-generation), NOT /media/sheep mount root. Keep Rework Poster library separate (/media/sheep/_refactor-preview).
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: ROKU CONSTRAINTS: Developer mode allows ONE sideloaded package per device — VoD channel and screensaver alternate; registry JellyFlam3 keys survive zip swap. Furnace-built zips embed registry/jellyflam3-presets.json via scripts/client_pack_presets.py. Commercial filtering is client-side (isCommercialSafe); never pass Tags= to Jellyfin Items API (AND semantics empty flock). VoD 1.0.30 always persists shuffleFlock=true on launch (package presets must not copy this key; leftover false from empty Settings save / older force-sync survives sideload otherwise). VoD 1.0.31 / Roku SS 1.0.9 wrap-refetch Jellyfin after a full shuffle permutation (Limit 5000, prune to 313; rotate past last-played). Roku screensaver ignores shuffleFlock and always rotates stills.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: IDLE GATE: jellyflam3-idlegate pauses worker when Jellyfin reports active TV playback (Roku Client=JellyFlam3). Roku Screensaver and Kodi screensaver use Client=JellyFlam3-Screensaver so gate stays open during stills/video screensaver. healthcheck.sh and bringup_check.sh fail closed on bad units, missing gate status, Opt In without live Syncthing+Tailscale. WORKER DRAIN (distinct): python3 -m pipeline.worker_drain request finishes the current inbox job then stops claiming until cancel; flag persists across restart; healthcheck WARNs while drained.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: DEFERRED / OUT OF SCOPE (do not document as shipped): Continuous live HLS from shuffled MP4s (dropped). Gold Sheep / paid ES masters (never ingest). DeepDream, full social flock network (aspirational). LLM pedigree + LLM poster naming are Phase 5 on a **separate** Ventuno LLM Agent Platform (docs/phase5/) — not on the Pi furnace, not cloud stubs in the worker, not Ventuno-as-furnace. Kodi standalone loop→edge→loop sequencer (tuples play as one catalog MP4). Channel Store / private Roku publish parked. Auto-promote, mesh introduce, vote overlay, library rotate parked. Hours-scale flock timer not needed (wrap-once shipped). Shipped Phase 4: tuples (03), 05 user-guide baseline, 06 disk check, 07 N_max estimator, 09 RNG aliases, sidecar key names, wrap-once flock refresh + 313 cap, worker drain.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: TESTING: python3 -m pytest tests/ -q (~3s local; ~372 tests collected). Fleet uses apt python3-pytest. smoke_render.sh and hls_smoke.sh are Pi/lab scripts not pytest. CI: .github/workflows/tests.yml + release.yml (tag push). ensure_exec_bits.sh --check on every CI run.

page_notes.content: Include 2026-08-23 confirmation: flat ParentId returned partial flock; folder walk returns full flock; client merge required. Roku VoD + screensaver verified after sideload 1.0.26/1.0.6.

stills/.ignore: catalog JPEGs are not Jellyfin Primaries or Backdrops. VoD FlockItem shows No poster without ImageTags.Primary. Roku SS mixes Primaries only until BackdropImageTags exist. Images POST must be base64 on Jellyfin 10.11.

Concerns: Jellyfin API behavior may change; child-folder walk capped at 50 direct folders under library; no server-side proxy yet; multi-Roku household needs Phase 4 publish or manual per-TV sideload; secrets in registry on Roku devices.
